title: Sirhan Sirhan as an MK Ultra subject linked to William Joseph Bryan
summary: Jesse Michels tells of Sirhan Sirhan as an MK Ultra subject linked to William Joseph Bryan, about 1968 at Santa Anita racetrack, California, and frames it as the host. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: Sirhan Sirhan himself was an MK Ultra patient because he had spent some time with William Jennings Brian

plain: A podcast host, Jesse Michels, says that Sirhan Sirhan, the man convicted of shooting Robert F. Kennedy in 1968, was himself a patient of MK Ultra, a secret CIA programme that experimented with mind control. Michels bases this on Sirhan having spent time with a man named William Joseph Bryan, with the story tied to the Santa Anita racetrack in California, which if true would mean the killing was shaped by government mind experiments.
